Horizon Blue Long Sleeve Cotton Classic

1

Crafted in soft cotton, the Horizon Blue Long-Sleeve Cotton Classic delivers a clean silhouette with versatile appeal. Its crisp finish balances casual ease with refined detail, making it a timeless essential for layering or standalone wear across seasons.

 

Material & Care

  • 100% Cotton

  • Machine wash cold, warm iron if needed

Why DRIPLINE?

We offer unique, high-quality apparel focusing on sustainable materials and timeless, durable designs.

When will i receive my Order?

Orders typically ship within 2 business days. Delivery times vary by location, usually 3-5 business days.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit & debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex etc.) for a secure checkout.

Are your products authentic?

Yes, you will receive a certificate of authenticity with each product to guarantee it.
